blocks.en: Appendix A Detailed methods
blocks.zh: 附录A 详细方法

blocks.en: A.1 Model and adaptation
blocks.zh: A.1 模型和适应

blocks.en: VGL-stGen adapts the attention and feed-forward projections of the language component of medgemma-1.5-4b-it [ 9 ] . The vision tower is frozen. The deployed model’s training stages use QLoRA with rank 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05, a 4-bit NF4 base with double quantisation, and bfloat16 computation. Eager attention is used; gradient checkpointing is disabled in these stages. The final cancer stage uses AdamW, peak learning rate 2e-4, 500 warmup steps, weight decay 0.01, and cosine warm restarts with a minimum learning rate of 1e-6. Sequence length is 1,536 and gradient accumulation gives an effective batch of 512 from a per-device batch of one. The separate expression-adaptation experiment below starts from the assembled rank-96 adapter and uses different optimisation settings.
blocks.zh: VGL-stGen调整了medgemma-1.5-4b-it语言成分的注意力和向导预测[9]. 观音塔结冰. 部署的模型的训练阶段使用16等的QLORA, α 32, distruct 0.05, 一个4位的NF4基础, 并进行双量化, 以及bfloat16计算. 使用Eager注意;在这些阶段,梯度检查被禁用。 最终癌症阶段采用亚当W,峰值学习速率2e-4,500热身步骤,体重衰减0.01,余弦热重开,最低学习速率为1e-6. 序列长度为1,536,梯度堆积从每批一个装置中给出有效批次为512. 下面单独的表达式适应实验从组装的等级-96适配器开始,并使用不同的优化设置.

blocks.en: Training comprises gene and cell-type adaptation with stepwise prompt variants, expression bins and stain augmentation; gene-mediated image-to-cell-type distillation; joint cancer training with transcriptomic replay; and checkpoint averaging. The cancer stage trains eleven objectives: nine replayed transcriptomic tasks and two cancer tasks. The distilled image-to-cell-type objective and the three stepwise prompt variants receive no direct supervision during cancer training. The joint image-and-genes cell-type task is served without a direct training objective.
blocks.zh: 培训内容包括:基因和细胞类型的适应,并带有相继的即时变体、表达箱和污损增殖;基因介导成像到细胞类型的蒸馏;联合癌症培训,并配有转录菌回放;检查站平均值。 癌症阶段训练有11个目标:9个重播的收音机任务和2个癌症任务. 蒸馏成像到细胞类型的目标以及三个阶梯的即时变体在癌症训练期间没有直接接受监督. 联合图像和基因细胞型任务在没有直接培训目标的情况下得到服务。

blocks.en: Cancer training stopped when its in-distribution validation loss plateaued. We use weight averaging [ 12 ] , representing the mean of six late adapters at rank 96 through concatenated low-rank factors and the corresponding adapter scaling. The averaging window was selected after comparing fifteen saved checkpoints on the 39-slide TCGA development subset. That subset is included in the expanded 452-slide evaluation.
blocks.zh: 癌症培训在分配确认损失稳定后停止。 我们使用平均重量[12],代表了6个后期适配器在96级的平均值,通过平缓的低级因子和相应的适配器缩放. 平均窗口是在比较了三十九度滑坡TCGA开发子集上节省的15个检查站之后选定的。 该子集被列入扩大的452-滑坡评价。

blocks.en: The adapter was trained on a quantised base and also merged into bfloat16 weights. Matched-subset score differences reach 0.0049, with the merged path higher for cancer and the adapter path higher for cell type. The main binary tumour benchmark uses merged weights; the main nine-class tissue and cell-type benchmarks use the adapter. Packaging, prompt and scoring path are therefore part of the reported operating condition.
blocks.zh: 适配器被训练在一个量化的基座上,同时也被合并为bfloat16重量. 匹配的子集得分差达到0.0049,癌症的合并路径较高,细胞类型适配器路径较高. 主要二进制肿瘤基准使用合并重量;主要九级组织和细胞类型基准使用适配器. 因此,包装、快速和评分路径是所报告的操作条件的一部分。

blocks.en: A.2 Training data and gene panels
blocks.zh: A.2 培训数据和基因板

blocks.en: The spatial training subset comprises 69 ST–H&E samples in PortraiATLAS, supplemented by single-cell reference profiles from the LuCA atlas [ 15 ] . Each sample pairs spatial gene expression with histology; the sample count does not denote independent patients. The combined transcriptomic corpus contains 1,745,240 cells or spots.
blocks.zh: 空间训练子集包括PortraiATLAS的69个ST-H&E样本,并由LUCA地图集的单细胞参考剖面补充[15]. 每个样本将空间基因表达与组织学对齐;样本计数并不表示独立的患者. 综合记录仪包含1,745,240个细胞或斑点。

blocks.en: A 2,000-gene panel was formed by ranking genes according to the number of source samples in which they were selected as highly variable. Gene identifiers were uppercased and punctuation other than hyphens was removed during preparation of the gene lists. The observed training top-gene lists contain 1,978 distinct identifiers, whereas the corresponding lists in the external benchmark contain 1,051. The two vocabularies share 1,049 identifiers; 929 occur only in the training lists and two only in the external lists. These counts describe observed gene-list vocabularies, not the full gene content of the assay panels. Gene lists are generated without a vocabulary constraint.
blocks.zh: 一个2000基因面板是由基因根据被选为高度可变性的来源样本数量排列而成. 基因识别符被大写,在编制基因清单时除连字符外的标注被移除. 观察到的训练顶级名单载有1 978个不同的识别符,而外部基准中的相应名单则包括1 051个。 这两个词汇共有1 049个识别符;929个只出现在培训名单中,两个只出现在外部名单中。 这些计数描述了观测到的基因列表词汇,而不是分析面板的全部基因内容. 基因列表生成时没有词汇限制.

blocks.en: Expression tasks use Absent for undetected counts and Low, Med, High and Very High for quartiles of detected expression within a cell or Visium spot. Rows sample 100 genes across bins, with a nominal allocation of 50 Absent, 15 Low, 15 Med, 10 High and 10 Very High. Gene order is shuffled before masking. These tasks produce 2,659,430 rows before stain expansion and 6,808,162 afterwards. Observed masked-expression training data cover 2,000 genes for the image task and 1,478 for the cell-type task. These task-specific counts differ from the shared encoded MLP vocabulary described below. The levels-to-cell-type prompt exposes only the first ten sampled gene–level pairs.
blocks.zh: 表达式任务使用未检测到的计数的缺漏,以及细胞或维西姆斑点内检测到的表达式的四分位数的低、中、高和非常高。 列样100个基因横跨垃圾箱,名义分配为50个缺位,15个低位,15个中位,10个高位和10个甚高位. 基因订单在蒙面前被洗涤. 这些任务在污迹扩张前产生2,659,430行,之后产生6,808,162行. 被观测到的蒙面表达训练数据涵盖2000个基因用于图像任务,1478个基因用于细胞类型任务. 这些任务特定计数不同于下文描述的共享编码的MLP词汇. 水平到细胞型的迅速只暴露了前十种抽样基因—水平对.

blocks.en: The cancer corpus contains 30,965 unique image patches and 92,895 task rows. The public annotated lung tissue source associated with ARA-CNN supplies 18,554 unique patches [ 13 ] . Pathologist annotations for this project cover the same 47 Xenium samples used for spatial training and three additional public tissue sections, contributing 12,411 retained non-overlapping patches with at least 80% labelled-region coverage. The binary manifest contains 12,411 task rows from each cancer data source. Both sources use nine tissue categories; the main binary mapping defines cancer as TUMOR only.
blocks.zh: 癌体包含30,965个独特的图像补丁和92,895个任务行. 与ARA-CNN相关的公共注解肺组织来源提供18,554个独特的补丁[13]. 该项目的病理学家说明涵盖用于空间培训的同样的47个nium样本和另外三个公共组织部分,贡献了12 411个保留了不重叠的补丁,至少标有80%的地区覆盖。 二进制表包含来自每个癌症数据源的12,411个任务行. 这两个来源都使用9个组织类别;主要二进制图将癌症定义为只有TUMOR.

blocks.en: A.3 Augmentation, sampling and stepwise instructions
blocks.zh: A.3 增强、取样和分步指示

blocks.en: Spatial-transcriptomic and pathologist-derived patches were extracted using a target resolution of 0.5 μ \mu m per pixel and a target size of 224 × \times 224 pixels, corresponding to a nominal 112- μ \mu m field of view. The LubLung source crops cover approximately 87 μ \mu m at 172 × \times 172 pixels; these crops were resized to 221 × \times 221 pixels and padded to 224 × \times 224 pixels without adding tissue context. TCGA classification patches were extracted at approximately 87 μ \mu m, whereas the TCGA application analyses used a 128- μ \mu m field of view. Two offline stain-normalized appearances supplement original image-bearing transcriptomic rows. The public cancer source is also stain-expanded; multiplicity differs across sources and tasks. Validation and test manifests are unexpanded. Earlier training additionally uses on-the-fly stain augmentation, including RandStainNA [ 43 ] and percentile normalization, with geometric and photometric transformations. The distillation and final cancer runs disable on-the-fly augmentation and retain the offline variants.
blocks.zh: 空间三角形和病理学家派生的补丁是利用目标分辨率为每像素0.5 μ \ mu m,目标大小为224 × \ times 224像素,相当于名义上的112 - μ \ mu mi的视场. LubLung源作物在172××时覆盖约87 μ\mu m;这些作物被调整为221××时221像素,加成224××时224像素而不增加组织上下文. TCGA分类补丁是在大约87 μ \mu m时提取的,而TCGA应用分析则使用了128 - μ \mu m的视野. 两个离线的污点正常外观补充了原始的带有图像的记录片行. 公共癌症来源也有污点扩大;各种来源和任务的多样性不同。 验证和测试清单没有扩大。 早期的训练还额外使用了飞行上的污渍增殖,包括RandStainNA[43]和百分位正常化,有几何和光度的转化. 蒸馏和最终的癌症使飞行增强功能失效,并保留离线变体。

blocks.en: The final sampler groups tasks into image-conditioned gene tasks, expression tasks, text-only gene and cell-type tasks, and cancer. Their initial shares are 0.30, 0.25, 0.20 and 0.25. Subsequent shares are computed from a softmax of the preceding epoch’s family validation losses, clamped to [0.10, 0.50] and renormalised. This gives the small cancer corpus an explicit sampling share. The token loss uses focal weighting [ 44 ] with gamma 2.0 and label smoothing 0.1. Inverse-frequency sample weights apply to the nine-class tissue task.
blocks.zh: 最终的采样者组任务为图像条件基因任务,表达任务,只文本基因和细胞型任务,以及癌症. 他们最初的股份是0.30,0.25,0.20和0.25. 其后的股份由前一个时代的家庭验证损失的软马克计算,压入[0.10,0.50],并重新正常化。 这使得小的癌症包具有明显的抽样份额。 令牌丢失采用焦重[44],加盖伽马2.0,标签平滑0.1. 反频样本权重适用于九级组织任务.

blocks.en: Three auxiliary task variants use step-by-step instructions (Table 5). Their prompts ask for biological interpretation before gene-based cell typing, cell-type characteristics before gene prediction, or morphology and biological processes before image-based gene prediction. Each variant samples one fifth of its source-task rows and retains the original class-label or gene-list targets. The resulting augmentation changes the instruction, without adding intermediate reasoning targets. Across training stages, twelve task types receive target supervision; the three instruction variants bring the objective count to fifteen. The deployed interface returns the requested labels or gene lists directly.
blocks.zh: 三个辅助任务变体采用分步指示(表5). 他们的提示在基于基因的细胞打字之前要求生物解释,在基因预测之前要求细胞类型特征,或者在基于图像的基因预测之前要求形态学和生物过程. 每个变种对其五分之一的源任务行进行抽样,并保留原类标签或基因列表目标. 由此产生的增强会改变指令,而不增加中间推理目标. 在整个培训阶段,有12个任务类别接受目标监督;三个教学变式使目标数达到15个。 部署的界面直接返回所要求的标签或基因列表.

blocks.en: Table 5: Stepwise prompt variants used in earlier training. Answer targets remain the original class labels or gene lists.
blocks.zh: 表5:早期培训中使用的逐步快速变体。 答案目标仍然是原始的类标签或基因列表.

blocks.en: A.4 Gene-mediated self-distillation
blocks.zh: A.4 基因调解的自我消化

blocks.en: Spatial data supply image–gene pairs and the atlas supplies gene–cell-type pairs. A gene-conditioned teacher scores each of the twelve cell-type labels by summing its answer-token log-probabilities. Its highest-scoring label becomes the target for the corresponding spatial image. The gap between the two highest scores defines the margin; a threshold of 1.0 retains 1.32M of approximately 1.75M candidate items. The 1.75M figure counts distillation candidates and does not denote an additional disjoint cohort.
blocks.zh: 空间数据提供图像-基因对和地图集提供基因-细胞型对. 一个基因有条件的老师通过对十二个细胞型标签的组合来对每个标签进行分数,即其答案-托肯对数概率. 它的最高得分标签成为相应的空间图像的目标. 两个最高得分的差距决定了比值;1.0的门槛值保留了1.32M左右的1.75M候选项目. 1.75M数字计算出蒸馏候选者,并不表示有额外的脱节组群。

blocks.en: The student uses 300,000 pseudo-labelled image rows and 200,000 replay rows for one epoch at learning rate 1e-4, with offline stain variants and eager attention. Replay retains supervision for the existing tasks during adaptation to the image-to-cell-type objective.
blocks.zh: 学生使用30万个伪标图像排和20万个重播排,以1e-4的学习速度为一个时代,有离线的污点变体和热切的注意. 重播保留了在适应图像到细胞类型目标时对现有任务的监督.

blocks.en: A.5 Classification decoding and probability correction
blocks.zh: A.5 分类解码和概率更正

blocks.en: VGL-stGen closed-label generation follows a prefix tree of permitted labels. Label tokens omit leading spaces and special tokens. Under its tokenizer, first tokens are distinct within each of the twelve-class cell-type, nine-class tissue and binary label sets. Its interface can therefore return a first-token argmax and the corresponding restricted softmax score. This score is a model output, without a calibration guarantee. Comparator tokenisation and readout adaptations are specified in the multimodal benchmark protocol.
blocks.zh: VGL-stGen闭标签生成遵循了允许标签的前缀树. 标签符省略了主位和特殊符符. 在它的代号器下,第一个代号在十二级细胞型,九级组织和二进制标签套件中各有区别. 它的接口因此可以返回一个第一token argmax和相应的限制性软max分数. 这个分数是一种模型输出,没有校准保证. 在多式联运基准协议中具体规定了比较符号化和读出修改。

blocks.en: The main gene-classification comparison uses constrained generation, yielding balanced accuracy 0.6293 and macro-F1 0.6023. First-token argmax evaluated in the same run yields 0.6272 and 0.6019; the paths agree on 99.703% of the 224,210 evaluated items. A separate generation evaluation of the same cohort yields 0.6297 and 0.6029 and provides the gene-only reference for the joint image-and-genes comparison. These are two evaluations of the same cohort.
blocks.zh: 主要基因分类比较采用受限生成,产生平衡精度0.6293和宏-F1 0.6023. 在同一次运行中评估的第一地对冲系数为0.6272和0.6019;在评估的224 210个项目中,路径为99.703%。 对同一组别进行的单独一代评价得出了0.6297和0.6029,为联合图像和基因比较提供了仅基因的参考。 这是对同一组人的两次评价。

blocks.en: The deployed-task evaluation and the multimodal comparison use task-specific greedy-generation limits: 8 new tokens for task 1, 16 for tasks 2–5, 160 for tasks 6–7, 56 for tasks 8–9, 128 for task 10 and 16 for task 13. Tasks 11–12 instead make 25 autoregressive expression-level decisions with fixed query names. Token limits are counted using each model’s tokenizer. VGL-stGen places text before the image and uses its fast image processor ( use_fast=True ); tasks 10–13 use eager attention, while tasks 1–9 use scaled dot-product attention. The multimodal benchmark preserves these task-specific inference settings while using each comparator’s native chat template and image processor. The separate expression-adaptation study keeps its common autoregressive readout fixed across its trained checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 部署的任务评价和多式联运比较使用特定任务贪婪生成的限制:任务1、16、2-5、160、6-7、56、8-9、128、10和16。 任务 11 – 12 转而使用固定的查询名称作出 25 个自动递归的表达式级别决定 。 托肯限额使用每个模型的标注器计算。 VGL-stGen将文本置于图像之前,并使用其快速图像处理器(使用_fast=True);任务10–13使用急切关注,而任务1–9使用缩放的点产品关注. 多式联运基准在使用每个参照国的本地聊天模板和图像处理器的同时保留了这些任务特定的推论设置. 单独的表情适应研究在经过训练的检查站内固定其常见的自动读出。

blocks.en: For the nine-class tissue-classification analysis, each class probability is divided by its mean across the target group, then the class scores are renormalised. The reported analysis pools first-token probabilities over the entire 39-slide subset. Macro-F1 changes from 0.1200 to 0.2801 on those same predictions. Estimation of the divisor uses no labels, but the choice to apply correction followed labelled evaluation. The analysis is therefore exploratory and transductive. Per-slide grouping defines a different operating condition.
blocks.zh: 对于九级组织分类分析,每级概率按其平均值在目标群体之间除以,然后类分重新正常化. 所报告的分析汇集了整个39个滑坡子集的第一概率。 宏-F1在这些相同的预测上从0.120变为0.2801. divisor的估算没有使用标签,但选择应用经过标签评价的校正. 因此,这种分析是探索性的和转录性的。 平滑组合定义了不同的操作条件.

blocks.en: For genes-to-cell-type, the analogous first-token correction increases balanced accuracy from 0.6272 to 0.6876 and decreases macro-F1 from 0.6019 to 0.4452. The main comparisons use uncorrected predictions. This trade-off also illustrates why a single classification metric is insufficient here.
blocks.zh: 对于基因对细胞类型,类似的第一吻修正将平衡精度从0.6272提高到0.6876,宏观F1从0.6019下降到0.4452. 主要比较使用未经修正的预测. 这种权衡也说明了为什么在此单项分类指标是不够的。

blocks.en: A.6 External cohorts and annotation dependence
blocks.zh: A.6 外部群体和对注解的依赖

blocks.en: The four external spatial sections are public 10x lung cancer datasets [ 16 ] : Visium CytAssist squamous carcinoma (3,775 spots), Visium CytAssist large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (6,189 spots), Xenium adenocarcinoma with multimodal segmentation (73,870 cells), and Xenium immuno-oncology with a custom add-on (140,376 cells). These counts are the processed evaluation units. The accompanying data-source manifest lists the official access links for these four datasets.
blocks.zh: 四个外部空间段为公共10x肺癌数据集[16]: 锡亚胺(CytAsist squamous carcinoma)(3,775个斑点),锡亚胺(CytAsist)大型细胞神经内分泌癌(6,189个斑点),具有多模式分化作用的nium亚胺(73,870个细胞),以及具有定制加成(140,376个细胞)的e免疫肿瘤. 这些计数是经过处理的评价单位. 所附的数据源列表列出了这四个数据集的官方访问链接.

blocks.en: TACCO [ 14 ] transfers these coarse LuCA cell-type annotations to each section; the largest transferred component defines the reference class. The resulting targets share an atlas and label definition with training. The pool contains 214,246 Xenium centre-cell questions and 9,964 Visium dominant-region questions. Xenium contributes 95.6% of the evaluated items. The pooled score therefore primarily reflects the single-cell setting.
blocks.zh: TACCO [14] 将这些粗细的LUCA细胞型说明传输到每个部分;最大的传输组件定义了参考类. 由此产生的目标与培训共用地图集和标签定义。 该池包含214,246个nium中心细胞问题和9,964个 Vi主区域问题. nium贡献了95.6%的评价项目. 因此,集合得分主要反映了单细胞的设定.

blocks.en: All four sections provide measured expression and were excluded from transcriptomic training. H&E from Visium LCNEC and the two Xenium sections supplies 4,846 of 24,822 binary cancer training rows; the Visium SCC source is absent from that manifest. This source-level check does not establish patient independence across all training stages. The two image-conditioned cell-type tasks and the two image-conditioned gene-list tasks therefore include previously seen tissue with unseen task labels. Gene-only tasks have no direct image input, but share the adapted weights. The pre-cancer cell-type checkpoint precedes this cancer-stage exposure; the deployed checkpoint follows it.
blocks.zh: 所有四个科都提供了有节制的表达方式,并且被排除在记录片培训之外。 来自Visium LCNEC和两个Xenium区段的H&E供应了24,822个二元癌训练列中的4,846个;Visium SCC源没有出现在该清单中. 这种来源一级的检查并不能在所有培训阶段确定病人的独立性。 因此,两个具有图像条件的细胞类型任务和两个具有图像条件的基因清单任务包括以前看到的带有隐形任务标签的组织. 只有基因的任务没有直接的图像输入,而是分享经过调整的权重. 癌前细胞型检查点在此癌症期暴露之前;部署的检查点在此之后。

blocks.en: TCGA-LUAD diagnostic images [ 17 ] provide 357,692 patches from 452 slides and 398 patients, using an 87 μ \mu m field of view. VGL-stGen predictions are evaluated against reference labels from SegLungTCGA maps generated by ARA-CNN [ 13 ] . TCGA supplies the tissue images; ARA-CNN supplies the computational reference annotations. ARA-CNN and the cancer training corpus share LubLung provenance. Neither VGL-stGen nor the deployment probes use TCGA for gradient training, but 39 of these slides informed model development, label mapping and checkpoint selection. The expanded evaluation includes those slides. Agreement with these computational labels cannot establish independent pathologist-level validity.
blocks.zh: TCGA-LUAD诊断影像[17]提供来自452个幻灯片和398个病人的357,692个补丁,使用87 μ\mu m的视场. VGL-stGen预测以ARA-CNN生成的SegLungTCGA地图的参考标签来评价. [13]. TCGA提供组织图象;ARA-CNN提供计算参考说明. ARA-CNN和癌症培训机构共享LubLung的出处。 VGL-stGen和部署探测器都没有使用TCGA进行梯度训练,但其中39个幻灯片为模型开发,标签映射和检查站选择提供了信息. 扩大的评价包括这些幻灯片。 与这些计算标签的协议不能建立独立的病理学家级有效性.

blocks.en: The TUMOR class accounts for 15.09% of evaluated patches. An always-negative classifier therefore scores 0.849 raw accuracy and 0.500 balanced accuracy. We report balanced accuracy as the principal binary metric, together with AUROC.
blocks.zh: TUMOR级占评估补丁的15.09%. 因此,一个总是否定的分类器对0.849的原始精度和0.500的平衡精度进行评分. 我们报告,平衡准确度是主要的二进制衡量标准,与AUROC一起。

blocks.en: A.7 Gene classifiers and adaptation-capacity control
blocks.zh: A.7 联合国 基因分类器和适应能力控制

blocks.en: External comparison inputs are the same twenty gene symbols in descending expression order. Realised coverage depends on each model’s vocabulary. The simple classifiers use a vocabulary learned from training lists, with either a multi-hot encoding or a rank weight (n-r)/n , where r starts at zero and n is the list length. Training lists include mixed lengths; external lists contain twenty genes. Logistic regression uses balanced class weights, the SAGA solver and up to 200 iterations. The MLP uses one hidden layer of 256 units, up to 40 iterations and internal early stopping, without class weights. Model hyperparameters are fixed.
blocks.zh: 外部比较输入在递减表达顺序上是相同的20个基因符号. 实际覆盖取决于每个模型的词汇。 简单的分类者使用从训练列表中吸取的词汇,或者多热编码,或者分级重(n-r)/n,其中r起始于0,n为列表长度. 培训名单包括混合长度;外部名单包括20个基因。 逻辑回归使用平衡类权重,SAGA解析器和最多200个迭代. MLP使用一个256个单元的隐藏层,最多40个迭代和内部早期停止,没有等级重量. 模型超参数是固定的。

blocks.en: The frozen cell-model panel contains Geneformer V2-104M and Geneformer V2-104M_CLcancer [ 25 ] , and two C2S-Scale variants, with generic-language controls. Inputs preserve rank and are mapped to native tokens or gene text. This evaluates ranked marker lists, rather than each model’s native full-profile task. scGPT is excluded because its expression-value input [ 45 ] would require an additional rank-to-value convention for this benchmark; its suitability for expression-valued assays is outside this comparison.
blocks.zh: 冷冻的细胞模型面板包含Geneformer V2-104M和Geneformer V2-104M_CLcancer [25],以及两个C2S级变体,具有通用语言控制功能. 输入保存等级,并被映射到原生的符号或基因文字. 而不是每个模型的本土全貌任务。 scGPT不在此列,因为其表达值输入[45]需要为这一基准制定额外的排序与价值的公约;它是否适合表达值分析,不属于这一比较范围。

blocks.en: Both Geneformer variants are fine-tuned on 581,394 source rows for two epochs, batch size 256 and maximum learning rate 5e-5. Training uses class-weighted cross-entropy, AdamW with weight decay 0.01, a OneCycleLR schedule and gradient clipping at 1.0. The final-epoch weights are evaluated on 224,210 external items.
blocks.zh: 两个Geneformer变体在581,394源行上均进行了微调,为两个纪元,批量大小256,最高学习率5e-5. 训练使用班级加权交叉切变,重量衰减0.01的亚当W,一个OneCycleLR时间表和1.0的梯度剪切. 对224,210件外部物品进行最终时间权重评价。

blocks.en: Balanced accuracy and macro-F1 are reported together: logistic regression leads on the former and VGL-stGen on the latter. The gene-classification MLP comparison is provisional because the reported fit and subsequent refits have not been reconciled. Its 0.5962 macro-F1 is shown descriptively and does not support a stable superiority claim for VGL-stGen. This comparator is distinct from the expression MLPs fitted and evaluated below.
blocks.zh: 平衡的准确性和宏观F1是一起报告的:后勤回归导致前者,VGL-stGen导致后者。 基因分类的MLP比较是暂时性的,因为所报的适配和随后的重配尚未调和. 它的0.5962宏-F1以描述方式显示,不支持VGL-stGen的稳定优越性主张. 这一参照系统不同于下文中安装和评价的 " MLP " 一词。

blocks.en: The adaptation-capacity control compares two readouts on the same backbone, loaded in bfloat16. The generative readout retains the pretrained language-model head and trains on label-answer tokens. The discriminative readout adds a newly initialised twelve-way linear head and uses class cross-entropy. Both use rank 16, alpha 32, learning rate 1e-4, batch eight, 6,000 updates, a 300,000-row training pool and 40,000 evaluation items. The discriminative and generative arms have 32,819,212 and 32,788,480 trainable parameters, respectively. Their macro-F1 scores are 0.5209 and 0.5683. The output head and loss change jointly, so this comparison concerns their combined configuration. No repeated-seed interval is available.
blocks.zh: 适应能力控制比较了同一主干上两个读出,装入bfloat16. generative readout保留了预先训练的语言模型头和在标签回答符号上的列车. 歧义读出会增加一个新登场的十二行线头,并使用类交叉切入. 两者均使用16级,α32级,学习率1e-4,第8批,更新6000个,30万排的训练池和40000个评价项目. 歧视性和遗传性武器分别有32 819 212和32 788 480个可训练参数。 他们的宏F1分数分别为0.5209和0.5683. 输出头和损失合并变化,因此这一比较涉及它们的组合. 没有重复种子间隔。

blocks.en: A.8 Image encoders and within-cohort reference fits
blocks.zh: A.8 联合国 图像编码器和码内参考

blocks.en: The cell-type morphology comparison uses fifteen frozen encoders, each followed by a class-balanced logistic probe with C=1.0 , L-BFGS and up to 2,000 iterations. Extracted encoder features receive no additional standardisation. Transferred probes train on gene-teacher pseudo-labels and are evaluated on 54,058 external items. Within-cohort references use five-fold stratified cross-validation over cells. VGL-stGen’s main image-to-cell-type scores use all 224,210 items; on the same 54,058-item subset as the probes, its three evaluated checkpoints score 0.1607, 0.2268 and 0.1998.
blocks.zh: 细胞型形态比较使用15个冷冻编码器,每个编码器后面有一个C=1.0的类平衡物流探测器,L-BFGS和最多2000个迭代. 提取的编码器特性没有获得额外的标准化. 基因教师假标签上的转移探测器列车,并接受54,058个外部物品的评价. 间距内参考使用5倍分层的交叉验证在细胞之上. VGL-stGen的主要图像对细胞型分数使用全部224,210项;在与探测器相同的54,058项子集上,其三个评估的检查站得分分别为0.1607,0.2268和0.1998.

blocks.en: The cancer comparison uses fourteen frozen encoders and a colour-histogram reference. Their deployment probes train on the same 30,965 unique cancer patches as VGL-stGen. Cancer features are L2-normalised; class-balanced logistic regression selects regularisation by grouped cross-validation within the source training data. A binary probe supplies the main comparison; nine-class-derived binary results are separate diagnostic arms. The model’s own medically adapted vision tower, called SigLIP in the result files, is also fitted with a linear probe as an additional control.
blocks.zh: 癌症比较使用十四个冷冻编码器和一个彩色-图像参考. 他们的部署探测器在与VGL-stGen相同的30,965个独特的癌症补丁上进行训练. 癌症特征是L2常态化;阶级平衡的物流回归在源培训数据中通过分组交叉验证选择规范化. 一个二进制探测器提供主比较;9级衍生的二进制结果是独立的诊断武器. 该模型自己的经医学改造的视觉塔,在结果文件中称为SigLIP,也安装了线性探测器作为附加控制.

blocks.en: For cancer reference fits, the target cohort is split into three patient-grouped folds. Each held-out patch receives an out-of-fold prediction. A matched-size arm trains on 30,965 target-fold patches at the source class balance; a full arm uses all available training-fold patches. Both use the regularisation selected on the matched subset. The full arm is not separately tuned, and the direction of any tuning effect is unknown. These comparisons constrain a simple sample-count explanation but do not isolate a causal contribution of cohort shift.
blocks.zh: 对于癌症参考物,目标组群被分为三个患者组群的折叠. 每个被搁置的补丁都得到一个外倍的预测. 在源类平衡下30,965个目标倍数补丁的匹配臂列车;全臂使用所有可用的训练倍数补丁. 两者都使用匹配子集上选择的正则化. 全臂不单独调谐,任何调谐效果的方向不明. 这些比较限制了简单的抽样统计解释,但并不孤立群移的因果关系。

blocks.en: The gene reference fits use five-fold cell-level cross-validation on approximately 100,000 external items. Cell and section dependence can make these references optimistic. The cancer folds instead separate patients. Scores from these different constructions should not be interpreted as directly comparable limits of biological information.
blocks.zh: 基因参考适合在约10万个外部物品上使用5倍细胞级交叉验证. 细胞和部分的依赖性可以使这些参考值保持乐观. 癌症将病人分开 这些不同构思的分数不应解释为生物信息的直接可比限度。

blocks.en: Within-cohort probe scores provide empirical supervised references for each representation. The transfer plots place target-cohort probe balanced accuracy on the horizontal axis and transferred balanced accuracy on the vertical axis. Both axes show empirical scores, not mathematical performance bounds. For imaging, VGL-stGen is compared with the reference from a probe on its own frozen tower; VGL-stGen itself is not adapted within the target cohort.
blocks.zh: 巡航内探测分数为每种表示提供了经验性监督参考。 转移地块将目标-焦距探测器的平衡精度放置在水平轴上,并将平衡精度放置在垂直轴上. 两轴都显示经验分数,而不是数学性能极限. 就成像而言,VGL-stGen与探测器在自身冷冻塔上的参考物进行比较;VGL-stGen本身在目标组内没有适应.

blocks.en: A.9 Gene-list evaluation
blocks.zh: A.9 基因清单评价

blocks.en: Four gene-list tasks use a seeded sample of 1,000 external items. Generation targets twenty genes; completion masks five of the twenty and supplies the remaining fifteen. The sample contains 949 Xenium cells and 51 Visium spots, with three cell types represented by at most three items. Gene-set F1 is 2|A ∩ \cap B| /(|A| +|B|) , averaged over items. These samples provide task-level estimates with little support for subgroup claims.
blocks.zh: 4个基因列表任务使用1000个外部物品的种子样本. 世代以20个基因为目标;完成面罩20个基因中的5个基因,供给其余15个基因. 样本中包含949个X基细胞和51个维西姆斑点,最多以3个项目代表3个细胞类型. Gene-set F1为2|A ∩\cap B| /(|A|QB|),在项目上均值. 这些样本提供了任务一级的估计数,很少支持分组索赔。

blocks.en: Completion evaluation prompts specify the actual number of withheld genes. Some training prompts specified output counts that differed from their targets.
blocks.zh: 完成评价提示指定了被扣基因的实际数量. 一些培训催化了与其目标不同的特定产出计数。

blocks.en: Training-global frequency rules provide transferable references. External-global and external-cell-type frequency rules use target-cohort statistics and provide descriptive comparisons with additional information. On image-to-gene generation, the training-global rule scores 0.0367, the external-global rule 0.2913 and the external-cell-type rule 0.4009. The last comparison changes both cohort and cell-type conditioning. None of these scores is a mathematical upper bound or a causal decomposition of the transfer gap.
blocks.zh: 全球频率培训规则提供可转让参考。 外部-全球和外部-细胞类型的频率规则使用目标协同统计,并提供与额外信息的描述性比较。 关于图像到基因生成,训练-全球规则得分0.0367,外部-全球规则0.2913和外部-细胞类型规则0.4009. 上一次比较既改变了组别,也改变了细胞类型的条件。 这些分数中没有一个是数学上限或转移间隙因果分解.

blocks.en: The frequency analysis counts one row per cell or spot: 1,221,886 training items and 224,210 external items, compared over 1,049 shared genes. The top-twenty frequency lists share five symbols. Panel coverage, cell composition and assay processing all differ between the cohorts, so their separate effects remain unresolved.
blocks.zh: 频率分析每细胞或点数1行:1,221,886个训练项目和224,210个外部项目,相比之下,共有基因超过1,049个。 最高20个频率列表共有5个符号. 小组的覆盖范围、细胞组成和化验处理都因组别不同而不同,因此它们各自的影响仍未得到解决。

blocks.en: Internal gene-list F1 is 0.4192, 0.3943, 0.3310 and 0.3972 for the four tasks. Within the image-to-gene split, recorded test cell/spot identifiers do not overlap its training split, but all 69 internal image-test samples also occur in training. The internal cell-type-to-gene evaluation covers effectively 4 classes. These conditions differ from the expression-task split described below.
blocks.zh: 内部基因列表F1为0.4192,0.3943,0.3310和0.3972,用于四项任务. 在图像到基因的分割中,记录的测试细胞/点识别符并不重复其培训分裂,但所有69个内部图像测试样本也在培训中出现. 内部细胞型对基因评价有效覆盖4个类. 这些条件不同于下文所述的表达式任务划分。

blocks.en: For a partial gene list without an image or cell-type input, the interface composes cell-type prediction with cell-type-conditioned completion. Its recorded F1 is 0.0472, compared with 0.0484 when supplied the reference cell type; the intermediate cell-type prediction is correct on 81.6% of sampled items. This is a composed interface operation rather than an additional directly trained task.
blocks.zh: 对于没有图像或细胞型输入的部分基因列表,界面以细胞型条件完成来构成细胞型预测. 其记录的F1为0.0472,而提供参考细胞类型时为0.0484;在81.6%的样本中,中间细胞类型预测是正确的. 这是一个由人构成的界面操作,而不是一项经过直接培训的额外任务。

blocks.en: A.10 Expression evaluation and image-shuffle controls
blocks.zh: A.10 表达式评价和图像显示控制

blocks.en: The expression-task training and test manifests have disjoint sample and recorded cell/spot identifiers. Each task is scored on 1,000 existing benchmark rows. The masked-image evaluation contains 665 Xenium cells and 335 Visium spots from seven samples. All seven samples are represented in gene-list training, and 692 benchmark cells or spots have matching identifiers and identical source images in that training set. The masked-cell-type benchmark uses the atlas-level identifier ‘LuCA_NCSCLC’, which is also present in gene-list training; its generated row-based cell identifiers do not establish a cross-task cell-barcode or donor linkage. These internal benchmarks therefore do not establish patient-independent generalisation across the full training sequence. The benchmark had already been analysed before the controlled adaptation study.
blocks.zh: 表达式任务培训和测试清单有脱节样本和记录的单元格/点标识符。 每个任务在1000个现有基准行上得分. 面具图像评价包含665个X细胞和7个样本的335个 Vi斑. 所有7个样本都出现在基因清单培训中,692个基准细胞或斑点在该培训集中有匹配的识别特征和相同的源图像。 遮盖细胞类型的基准使用地图集级别的标识符‘LuCA_NCSCLC',它也存在于基因列表培训中;其生成的以行为基础的细胞标识符没有建立跨任务细胞条码或捐赠者链接. 因此,这些内部基准并没有确立整个培训序列中病人的独立概括。 在有控制的适应研究之前,已经对基准进行了分析。

blocks.en: In the deployed model, the masked-expression objectives were trained without conditioning gene lists. Both decoding procedures use the same checkpoint and evaluation rows. This comparison measures inference behaviour for those weights. The separate adaptation experiment supplies fully conditioned examples to both loss conditions and holds their inference procedure fixed.
blocks.zh: 在部署的模型中,蒙面表达目标在不附带基因清单的情况下得到训练. 解码程序都使用相同的检查站和评价行. 这种比较测量了这些重量的推断行为。 单独的适应实验为损失条件提供了充分条件,并固定了推断程序。

blocks.en: Free generation is scored as emitted. Fixed-name decoding parses the twenty-five masked entries from the supplied hundred-gene list, then predicts each level from five permitted first tokens. Two independent extractors identify the same masked entries on all 176,008 held-out masked-task rows. Autoregressive decoding conditions each slot on the model’s previous level answers. Pair-F1 over the fixed names equals slot-level accuracy. These results apply to the specified input format.
blocks.zh: 自由生成被评为释放。 固定名称解码从提供的百基因列表中解析出25个蒙面条目,然后从5个允许的首字母符号中预测每个关卡. 两个独立的提取器识别出所有176 008个被搁置的蒙面任务行上相同的蒙面条目. 自动递归解码条件 模型之前的关卡答案上的每个槽. 固定名称上的对等-F1等于档位的精确度. 这些结果适用于指定的输入格式。

blocks.en: Per-gene and gene-by-cell-type tables are estimated from the training split. Their scores are 0.6198 and 0.6963. Both omit the seventy-five visible gene levels available to VGL-stGen. The deployed autoregressive scores are 0.6596 and 0.6858, with paired model-minus-table row intervals of [+0.0350, +0.0445] and [ − - 0.0160, − - 0.0052]. Context-aware MLPs on these same rows give three-seed mean pair-F1s of 0.6811 and 0.7300, respectively. The MLPs align available inputs and targets but use different encoders and training histories.
blocks.zh: 从训练分裂中估算出每个基因和每个细胞的基因。 他们的分数分别为0.6198和0.6963. 两者都省略了VGL-stGen可用的75种可见基因水平. 部署的自动递减分数为0.6596和0.6858,对偶的型号减式排行间隔为[+0.0350,+0.0445]和[−-0.0160,−-0.0052]. 同一行上的背景感MLP分别给出0.6811和0.7300的三种子平均对F1. MLPs调整了现有的投入和目标,但使用不同的编码器和培训历史。

blocks.en: Image-shuffle diagnostics retain the expression prompt and replace the paired image. Under teacher-forced preceding answers, the intact-minus-shuffled effect is 0.0097 [0.0071, 0.0124] for VGL-stGen and 0.0001 [ − - 0.0010, +0.0012] for the base model. With preceding answer positions fixed to Absent, VGL-stGen’s effect is 0.0092 [0.0067, 0.0119]. These settings differ from autoregressive generation and cannot be subtracted from its model-minus-table margin to assign a fraction of the gain to images.
blocks.zh: 图像-shuffle诊断保留表达式的即时,并替换配对的图像. 在教师强制之前的答案下,完好无损的减震效果为VGL-stGen0.0097 [0.0071,0.0124],基础模型0.0001 [−-0.0010,+0.0012]. 先前的回答位置固定在缺席状态下,VGL-stGen的效果为0.0092 [0.0067,0.0119]. 这些设置与自动递归生成不同,不能从它的模型-减去表边距中减去,以将收益的一小部分分配给图像.

blocks.en: Very-high-gene prediction is evaluated with the true answer length supplied. The model scores 0.2828; the 0.2247 frequency and 0.0144 random references use evaluation-shard gene support and answer lengths. Levels-to-cell-type prediction scores 0.7420 raw accuracy from the first ten sampled pairs. Its majority reference of 0.362 is selected within evaluation shards. These task-specific references use evaluation information, whereas the masked-completion frequency tables use training data. Reported scores aggregate four evaluation shards.
blocks.zh: 甚高基因预测用所提供的真实答案长度来评价。 模型得分0.2828;0.2247频率和0.0144随机参考使用评价-硬基因支持和答题长度. 水平对细胞类型的预测从最初的十对样本中得出0.7420的原始精度. 其0.362的多数参考数字是在评价碎片中选定的。 这些具体任务的参考文献使用评价信息,而蒙面完成频率表使用培训数据。 报告得分合计4个评价分数。

blocks.en: A.11 Context-aware expression baselines
blocks.zh: A.11 了解背景的表达基线

blocks.en: MLPs encode all 100 supplied gene–state pairs, including 75 observed levels and 25 masks, by summed embeddings divided by ten and layer normalisation. After concatenating the extra inputs, two hidden linear layers with GELU activations and dropout 0.1 after the first hidden layer predict five levels per gene. All variants share a training-derived vocabulary of 2,000 genes plus an unknown entry; five-class cross-entropy is applied only to the 25 queried genes. The context-only image-task model receives an indicator specifying a centre-cell or tissue-region query. The full image model additionally receives frozen 1,536-dimensional UNI2-h CLS features [ 40 ] ; the cell-type model receives the supplied twelve-class one-hot label plus an unknown category.
blocks.zh: MLPs编码了所有100种提供的基因-状态配对,包括75个观测水平和25个口罩,通过总的嵌入除以10和层的正常化. 在调和额外输入后,在第一个隐藏层预测每个基因的5级后,有两个带有GELU激活和退出的隐藏线性层0.1. 所有变种都有一个训练产生的词汇,有2,000个基因加上一个未知的条目;5级的交叉基因仅适用于25个被询问的基因. 只有上下文的图像任务模型收到一个指定中心细胞或组织区域查询的指标. 完整的图像模型额外得到1,536维的UNI2-h CLS特性[40];细胞型模型得到所提供的十二级一热标签加上一个未知的类别.

blocks.en: UNI2-h processes the same RGB images resized to 224 pixels and normalised by ImageNet statistics. Features are standardised using training-set means and population standard deviations, floored at 1e-4. This extractor applies no additional stain or geometric augmentation. The raw images, visible expression, query names, target levels and query-region or cell-type inputs are aligned with VGL-stGen. The comparison does not match vision encoders or staged training histories.
blocks.zh: UNI2-h处理相同的RGB图像调整到224像素,并由ImageNet统计实现正常化. 特征通过培训手段和人口标准差标准化,下限为1e-4。 此提取器不应用额外的污点或几何增强. 原始图像,可见表达式,查询名称,目标级别和查询区域或单元格类型的输入都与VGL-stGen对齐. 这种比较与视觉编码器或培训历史不符。

blocks.en: The original task splits supply 1,037,183 image training rows, 292,532 cell-type training rows and 10,000 validation rows per task. AdamW uses batch 1,024, weight decay 1e-4, a maximum of twenty epochs and validation patience three. A seed-42 search over widths 256/512 and learning rates 1e-3/3e-4 selects width 256 for the context-only image-task and cell-type models, and width 512 for the full image model, all at learning rate 1e-3. The selected settings are repeated at seeds 7 and 2026; each run uses its validation-selected epoch. Configurations and weights are fixed before test scoring. Image validation contains Xenium only, whereas the benchmark includes both platforms.
blocks.zh: 原任务分工提供1037,183个图像训练排,292,532个细胞型训练排和10000个验证排每任务. 亚当W使用批量1,024,重量衰减1e-4,最多20个纪元和验证耐心3. 种子-42在宽度256/512和学习率1e-3/3e-4选择宽度256用于上下文的图像任务和细胞型模型,宽度512用于全图像模型,均按学习率1e-3. 选定的设置在种子 7 和 2026 中重复;每次运行都会使用其验证选择的时代. 配置和权重在测试积分前固定. 图像验证只包含Xenium,而基准包含两个平台.

blocks.en: The context-only image-task MLP has mean pair-F1 0.6666. The full image MLP reaches 0.6811, but the two selected configurations differ in width as well as input. A separate width-512 matched-setting comparison has image-added differences of − - 0.0024, +0.0231 and +0.0141 across seeds; the direction is not consistent. Neither comparison establishes that images are dispensable or isolates a universal imaging advantage.
blocks.zh: 仅上下文的图像任务 MLP 表示对-F1 0.6666. 完整的图像MLP达到0.6811,但两个选定的配置在宽度和输入上都有所不同. 单独的宽度-512匹配设置比较在种子之间有−-0.0024,+0.0231和+0.0141的图像添加差异;方向不一致. 两者的比较都没有确定图像是可支配的,也没有分离出普遍成像优势。

blocks.en: A.12 Controlled expression adaptation and image permutation
blocks.zh: A.12 控制下的表达式适应和图像演化

blocks.en: Both conditions initialise from the same deployed rank-96 adapter. They share 4,096 additional training rows: 1,024 Xenium image, 1,024 Visium image and 2,048 cell-type rows. Additional training uses a fixed subset of the existing task-training data. The complete 100-gene list, 75 observed levels, image or supplied cell type, answer order and row order are identical between conditions. Training uses seeds 42, 7 and 2026, with no replay of other tasks.
blocks.zh: 从同一部署的96级适配器中关闭。 他们共用另外4 096个训练排:1 024个Xenium图像,1 024个 维西姆图像和2,048个细胞型排. 其他培训使用现有任务培训数据的固定子集。 完整的100基因列表,75个观测到的关卡,图像或提供的单元格类型,回答顺序和行顺序在条件上是相同的. 训练使用种子42,7和2026,没有重播其他任务.

blocks.en: Full-answer supervision applies mean full-vocabulary cross-entropy to all answer tokens and end-of-turn. Level-only supervision applies it to exactly the first tokens of the 25 requested levels; other answer positions receive no direct loss. This changes supervised positions without introducing a five-class-normalised training loss or a new prediction head. Both conditions use autoregressive inference from the model’s own preceding level predictions, restricted to the same five permitted first tokens.
blocks.zh: 全答监督适用于所有答音符和转折的全答音符。 仅限级别监督将其应用到25个要求级别中的确切首字母符号;其他答题位置没有直接损失. 这种变化在不引入五级规范化培训损失或新的预测头的情况下对职位进行监督。 这两种条件都使用模型本身先前水平预测的自递推论,仅限于相同的五个允许的第一标志。

blocks.en: Each run uses 256 updates, effective batch 16, AdamW learning rate 5e-5, sixteen linear warmup updates followed by a constant rate, weight decay 0.01, betas (0.9, 0.999), epsilon 1e-8 and gradient clipping at 1.0. The base is NF4 double-quantised with bfloat16 autocast; trainable language-side adapter parameters are float32, rank 96, alpha 32 and dropout 0.05. The vision tower and projector remain frozen. Gradient checkpointing is enabled. The terminal checkpoint is used without a learning-rate or intermediate-checkpoint search.
blocks.zh: 每跑使用256次更新,有效的第16批,亚当W学习速率5e-5,16次线性热速率更新,然后是恒定速率,重量衰减0.01,βs(0.9,0.999),epsilon 1e-8和梯度剪接1.0. 基地为NF4双量级,采用bfloat16自动播音;可训练语言侧适配器参数为float32,排名96,α32和退赛0.05. 视觉塔和投影机仍然被冻结. 启用渐变检查 。 终端检查站使用时没有学习率或中间检查点查询。

blocks.en: Development evaluation uses 96 Xenium, 96 Visium and 128 cell-type rows. Three Visium samples are selected by a fixed hash of sample names, excluded entirely from additional training, and sampled at 32 rows each. Those samples were present in the initial model’s training corpus. Other cross-family exposure is unverified. The equal-weight mean pair-F1 across these three groups and three seeds selects level-only as the representative supervision condition. The representative seed is fixed at 42, independent of its benchmark score. Both conditions at all three seeds are retained for the reported benchmark comparison, with weights and evaluation rows fixed before scoring.
blocks.zh: 开发评价使用96个X,96个 Vi和128个细胞型排. 三个Visium样本由固定的散列样本名称选择,完全不参加附加训练,每组样本为32行. 这些样本见于最初的示范培训书。 其他跨家庭接触未经证实。 这三个组的等重平均对-F1和三个种子只选择等级作为代表性监督条件. 代表性种子固定在42个,独立于其基准分数. 所有三种种子的这两个条件都保留,用于报告的基准比较,在评分前固定权重和评价行。

blocks.en: Table 6 reports level macro-F1 and accuracy on non-Absent targets; these reveal performance obscured by the frequent Absent class. Table 7 reports every seed and platform. Level-only image pair-F1 exceeds full-answer training at all seeds on both platforms. Cell-type pair-F1 does not improve beyond full-answer training, although its secondary metric means are slightly higher. The MLP retains higher means on both secondary metrics in both tasks.
blocks.zh: 表6报告宏观-F1级和未达标目标的准确性;这些显示的业绩被经常缺勤的阶层所掩盖。 表7报告每个种子和平台。 单级图像配对-F1超过两个平台上所有种子的全答训练. 细胞型配对-F1的改进并不超出全答训练,尽管其二级度量手段略高. MLP在两项任务中都保留了较高的二级指标。

blocks.en: Table 6: Secondary expression metrics on the same benchmark rows. Mean ± \pm sample SD across 3 individual seeds; the deployed checkpoint is a single fitted model. Non-Absent accuracy restricts targets to the 4 detected-expression levels.
blocks.zh: 表6: 同一基准行的二级表达式指标。 平均 ±\pm 抽样 SD 跨越 3 个种子; 部署的检查点是一个单一的安装模型。 非现成精度将目标限制在4检测到的表达水平.

blocks.en: Table 7: Every additional-training seed and image platform. The pooled image set contains 665 Xenium cells and 335 Visium spots; the cell-type set contains 1,000 rows. Difference is level-only minus full-answer pair-F1. These repeat additional training from one initial checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 表7:每个额外的训练种子和图像平台. 集合的图像集包含665个X电池和335个ium斑;细胞类型集包含1000行. 差异为只级别减全答对-F1. 这些再次从一个初始检查站接受额外培训。

blocks.en: For all six additional-training checkpoints, rows within each sample and original platform are deterministically ordered by a SHA-256 hash of their identifiers. Each row receives the next row’s image, wrapping the final row to the first. Every donor image differs from the original. Visible expression, targets and autoregressive decoding are unchanged. On the pooled image benchmark, the intact-minus-permuted pair-F1 difference is positive in each seed: full-answer 0.00504/0.00632/0.00656 and level-only 0.00796/0.00712/0.00820 for seeds 42/7/2026. Mean differences are 0.00597 and 0.00776, with sample CIs [0.00316, 0.00764] and [0.00263, 0.01042]. The paired difference between these effects is +0.00179, row CI [ − - 0.00097, 0.00460] and sample CI [ − - 0.00067, 0.00336]. Level-only’s normal-input advantage of 0.00848 remains 0.00669 after permutation. These comparisons establish sensitivity to correctly paired images on the pooled benchmark under both objectives; they do not establish that level-only training increased that sensitivity. No full thirteen-task evaluation was performed for the additional-training checkpoints; the task inventory and classification results refer to the deployed model.
blocks.zh: 对所有另外6个训练检查站而言,每个样本和原始平台的排数由SHA-256散列识别器定夺。 每行都收到下一行的图像,将最后一行包装到第一行. 每个捐赠者的形象都与原作不同. 可见的表达式,目标和自旋解码没有变化. 在集合图像基准上,每个种子中完好无损的比对-F1的差数为正数:全答0.00504/0.00632/0.00656,种子42/7/2026只有水平0.0796/0.00712/0.00820. 平均差异为0.00597和0.00776,样本为CI[0.00316,0.00764]和[0.00263,0.01042]. 这些效应的配对差为+0.00179,行CI[−-0.00097,0.0460]和样品CI[−-0.00067,0.0336]. 仅限水平的正常输入优势为0.0848,在通气后仍为0.0669. 这些比较确定了在两个目标下的集合基准上正确配对图像的敏感性;它们没有确定只有水平培训才能提高这种敏感性。 对额外训练检查站没有进行全面的十三项任务评价;任务清单和分类结果参照部署的模式。

blocks.en: Table 8 reports every intact and permuted score in the six-checkpoint comparison.
blocks.zh: 表8在6个检查点的比较中报告每个完好无缺的得分。

blocks.en: Table 8: Image pairing under both supervision conditions. Each seed is evaluated on the same 1,000 rows and 25 queried levels per row with 75 observed levels. The within-sample/platform image permutation is identical across all 6 checkpoints. Positive differences indicate higher pair-F1 with intact images.
blocks.zh: 表8:两种监理条件下的图像配对. 每颗种子都在同一1 000行和每行25个被问及的级别上进行评估,观察到75个级别。 所有6个检查站的样本/平台内图像布置相同。 正差表示较高对-F1的图像完好无损.

blocks.en: A.13 Completion with fewer observed expression levels
blocks.zh: A.13 完成后观测到的表达级别减少

blocks.en: We retain the same 1,000 image rows, 25 queried genes, target levels and image permutation while reducing observed gene levels from 75 to 50 and 25. Within each row, observed genes are deterministically ordered by a SHA-256 hash of the row identifier and upper-case gene name. The first 50 or 25 are retained in their original relative order, yielding nested subsets independent of target levels or predictions. Exact hashing specifications for gene selection and image permutation accompany the source data. Excluded observed pairs are removed from the prompt; the 25 original query masks remain. Expression-level definitions and targets are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了同样的1000个图像行,25个被询问的基因,目标水平和图像穿透,同时将观测到的基因水平从75个降低到50个和25个. 在每行中,观察到的基因由一列标识符和大写基因名的SHA-256散列来定型订购. 前50或前25个按其原始相对顺序保留,产生与目标水平或预测无关的巢状子集. 源数据附有基因选择和图像穿透的精确散列规格。 被排除的观测对被从提示中移除;保留了25个原始的查询口罩. 表达式一级的定义和目标保持不变。

blocks.en: The VGL-stGen checkpoint is the development-selected level-only seed 42. Image-inclusive and context-only MLPs use their existing matched-width fits (512, learning rate 0.001, seeds 42/7/2026). Excluded MLP input tokens become padding; query masks, the recipient’s centre-cell/region query indicator, training-derived feature normalisation and all weights remain fixed. Only image features are permuted in the image-inclusive MLP. These are inference-time stress conditions for models trained with 75 observed levels, with no budget-specific retraining.
blocks.zh: VGL-stGen检查站是开发所选等级的42号种子. 包含图像且只有上下文的 MLP 使用它们现有的配对宽配(512,学习速率0.001,种子42/7/2026). 不包括的 MLP 输入符成为粘贴; 查询口罩, 接收者的中心细胞/区域查询指示器, 训练产生的特性正常化和所有重量保持不变 。 只有图像特性在包含图像的MLP中被穿透. 这些是接受75个观测水平培训的模型的推断-时间压力条件,没有针对预算的再培训。

blocks.en: Table 9 gives all budgets, image conditions and secondary metrics. The primary budget contrast is the intact-minus-permuted image effect at 25 observed levels minus that at 75. Paired row and sample bootstrap preserve the original platform mixture, conditional on the fixed models, one image permutation and one nested-subset rule. This analysis evaluates reduced input context within synthetic marker-panel queries; it does not establish performance for a smaller assay panel or measurement-cost savings.
blocks.zh: 表9列出所有预算、图像条件和二级衡量标准。 基本预算对比是,在观测到的25个水平上,图像效果完好无损,减去75个水平。 Paired rain and sample boiltrap 保存原始平台混合物,以固定模型,一个图像穿透和一个嵌入子集规则为条件. 这一分析评价了合成标记-小组查询中输入量减少的情况;它没有确定较小的化验面板或测量成本节省的性能。

blocks.en: Table 9: Synthetic completion under reduced observed context, with the same 25 queries. Obs. denotes observed gene levels. VGL-stGen uses the development-selected level-only seed 42; MLPs report mean ± \pm sample SD across 3 fixed seeds (width 512, learning rate 0.001). All models retain weights trained with 75 observed levels. The context-only MLP has no image input.
blocks.zh: 表9:在减少观测到的语境下合成完成,有相同的25个查询。 obs表示观测到的基因水平. VGL-stGen使用开发所选择的仅级种子42;MLPs报告表示±\pm样本SD跨越3个固定种子(width 512,学习速率0.001). 所有型号都保留了经过75级观测的重量。 只有上下文的 MLP 没有图像输入 。

blocks.en: For the fixed VGL-stGen checkpoint, intact-image pair-F1 is 0.68032, 0.66808 and 0.65992 at 75, 50 and 25 observed levels. Image-pairing effects are +0.00796, +0.00720 and +0.01032; the latter two have sample CIs [0.00200, 0.01125] and [0.00561, 0.01443]. The 25-minus-75 change in image effect is +0.00236, row CI [ − - 0.00180, 0.00644] and sample CI [ − - 0.00037, 0.00543], leaving a pooled increase unresolved. The corresponding point changes differ across Xenium (+0.00481) and Visium ( − - 0.00251).

At 25 observed levels, VGL-stGen pair-F1 is higher than the image-MLP mean (0.65992 versus 0.64691), while non-Absent accuracy (0.2164 versus 0.2968) and level macro-F1 (0.3839 versus 0.4215) are lower. These results document a metric-specific trade-off under reduced context, rather than an overall completion advantage. All budgets and image conditions are retained in the table and accompanying source data.
blocks.zh: 在25个观测到的水平上,VGL-stGen配对-F1比图像-MLP平均值(0.65992对0.64691)更高,而非正时精度(0.2164对0.2968)和级宏F1(0.3839对0.4215)更低. 这些成果记录了在缩小背景的情况下,而不是总体的完成优势下,一种针对具体指标的权衡。 所有预算和图像条件均保留在表格及所附来源数据中。

blocks.en: A.14 Alignment checks and cancer label definitions
blocks.zh: A.14 对齐检查和癌症标签定义

blocks.en: Segmentation colour maps are aligned to slides by axis-wise linear scaling. A tissue-mask comparison searches translations over ± \pm 8% of a common grid; the unshifted alignment is optimal on all 452 slides, aspect-ratio error is at most 0.0009, and horizontal or vertical flips do not improve the fit. This evaluates geometric registration independently of the biological correctness of the segmentation labels.
blocks.zh: 分块色彩图通过轴向线性缩放与幻灯片对齐. 在普通网格的±\pm 8%上进行组织-mask比较搜索翻译;在所有452个幻灯片上,无转动的对齐是最佳的,侧面-角差错最多为0.0009,水平或垂直翻转并不能改善对齐. 这独立于分解标签的生物正确性来评价几何注册.

blocks.en: Tissue-mask quality control identifies 4,999 nearly empty tiles, or 1.40% of the evaluated set. Excluding them changes balanced accuracy from 0.7532 to 0.7519; restricting evaluation by the alignment threshold gives 0.7596. These post-hoc sensitivity analyses accompany the unfiltered estimate.
blocks.zh: 组织掩体质量控制可以识别出4,999块几乎是空的瓦片,占评估的一组的1.40%. 将它们排除在外后,平衡的准确性从0.7532改为0.7519;按对齐阈值限制评价则给予0.7596。 这些热后敏感性分析与未过滤的估算值相伴.

blocks.en: To assess overlap with known development patients, we exclude all slides belonging to the 39 patients represented by the 39-slide development subset. This removes 40 slides and 31,574 patches, leaving 412 slides, 359 patients and 326,118 patches. With unchanged predictions, VGL-stGen’s observed balanced accuracy is 0.7523, patient-bootstrap CI [0.7407, 0.7628], and AUROC 0.8253, compared with observed balanced accuracy 0.7534 on the full cohort. The original 0.7532 headline is a slide-bootstrap mean. Comparator probes are reconstructed using their original source-training settings and verified against their full-cohort scores before the patient exclusion. VGL-stGen remains sixth among the fifteen systems; the own-tower probe is an additional control outside this ranking. This sensitivity analysis does not remove adaptive development, shared annotation lineage or possible foundation-model pretraining exposure.
blocks.zh: 为了评估与已知发育病人的重叠情况,我们排除了属于39个发展子集所代表的39个病人的所有幻灯片。 这移除了40张幻灯片和31,574个补丁,留下了412张幻灯片,359个病人和326,118个补丁. VGL-stGen的观测到的平衡精度为0.7523、病人-bootstrap CI [0.7407, 0.7628] 和AUROC 0.8253, 相比之下,整个组的观测到的平衡精度为0.7534。 最初的0.7532头条是滑动-bootstrap平均值. 比较器探测器使用其原始的源训练设置进行重建,并在患者被排除之前对照其全焦分数进行校验. VGL-stGen在15个系统中仍为第六;自转探测器是这一排名以外的额外控制. 这种灵敏度分析并不能消除适应性发育,共享注释线条或可能的基建模型预培训曝光.

blocks.en: The label-definition comparison refits each encoder probe under the wide mapping ( TUMOR , NECROSIS and MIXED positive) and the TUMOR -only mapping on the same 452-slide cohort. Its median paired balanced-accuracy difference is 0.1191 across the fourteen encoders and 0.0436 for the colour reference. Each encoder’s patient-paired interval excludes zero. Both target definition and fitted classifier change, so the result measures benchmark sensitivity rather than the clinical superiority of one mapping. The mapping was chosen during development.
blocks.zh: 在宽映射(TUMOR,NECROSIS和MIXED正数)和TUMOR-仅在452-滑坡群上进行映射下,标签定义比较重新适应每个编码器探测器. 它的中位对称的平衡-准确性差在14个编码器之间为0.1191,彩色参考器为0.0436. 每个编码器的病人间隔不包括0。 无论是目标定义还是适应分类器变化,结果都衡量基准敏感性,而不是一次绘图的临床优势. 绘制地图是在开发期间选定的。

blocks.en: A.15 Statistical analysis
blocks.zh: A.15 统计分析

blocks.en: Binary cancer intervals use 1,000 slide-bootstrap draws, with patient-bootstrap intervals to account for patients contributing multiple slides. The empirical balanced accuracy is 0.7534 and its bootstrap mean is 0.7532. The slide interval is [0.7452, 0.7610]; the patient interval is [0.7441, 0.7622]. Neither incorporates annotation error, repeated-training variation or selection bias.
blocks.zh: 二元癌间距使用1000个滑坡拉图,患者-跳坡拉图间距用于说明造成多次滑坡的患者. 经验平衡精度为0.7534,其靴子平均精度为0.7532. 滑行间隔为[0.7452,0.7610];患者间隔为[0.7441,0.7622]. 也没有列入注释错误、反复训练的变异或选择偏差。

blocks.en: The principal paired cell-type comparisons use 2,000 hierarchical bootstrap draws, resampling four sections and then items within each sampled section. The same resampled indices are used for both systems. With only four sections, these intervals remain sensitive to the observed cohort composition. They should be read alongside section-specific results, not as strong evidence about a population of new patients. The retained Geneformer fine-tuning comparison instead uses cell-level resampling. The deployed model’s expression and image-shuffle intervals resample rows.
blocks.zh: 主配对的单元格类型比较使用2000个等级的靴子图纸,再对4个部分进行复制,然后在每个取样部分内进行项目。 两种系统都使用同样的重印指数。 只有四个部分,这些间隔对观察到的组群组成仍然敏感。 它们应与具体章节的结果一并阅读,而不是作为新病人人数的有力证据。 保留后的Geneformer微调比较则使用单元格级复刻. 已部署的模型的表达式和图像洗刷间隔重现行 。

blocks.en: The controlled adaptation study reports means and sample standard deviations across three individually fitted models, not ensembles. Paired contrasts first average matched-seed per-row differences and then use 2,000 bootstrap draws. Image row intervals resample rows within platform; image sample intervals resample samples with replacement within platform, retain all their rows and preserve the fixed Xenium/Visium mixture. Sample identifiers are not verified patients. The cell-type benchmark has only one sample identifier, so no sample-generalisation interval is estimated. Intervals condition on the fitted models and do not estimate a population of training seeds. The three seeds vary additional training from a common initial checkpoint, not the entire pretraining and adaptation history.
blocks.zh: 受控适应研究报告是指在三个单独安装的模型中,而不是在组合中,对标准偏差进行抽样。 Paired对比了第一平均匹配的每行种子差异,然后使用2000个靴子拉图. 图像行间隔在平台内重新采样;图像样本间隔在平台内重新采样,更换,保留其所有行并保存固定的X/Vis混合物. 样本识别器不是经核实的患者. 细胞类型基准只有一个样本标识符,因此没有样本通用间隔估计. 适配型号的间隔条件,不估计训练种子的数量。 这三个种子从一个共同的初始检查站,而不是整个训练前和适应史上,都不同的额外训练.

blocks.en: Balanced accuracy and macro-F1 are reported jointly. Confidence intervals for model-performance comparisons are not adjusted for multiple comparisons. A confidence interval crossing zero is not evidence of equivalence or non-inferiority.
blocks.zh: 平衡准确性和宏观F1是联合报告的. 模型-性能比较的置信间隔不因多次比较而调整. 置信间隔跨越0不是等同或非等同的证据.

blocks.en: A.16 Data and code availability
blocks.zh: A.16 数据和代码可用性

blocks.en: Code and weights are hosted at https://huggingface.co/Portraier/VGL-stGen-0.5-Lung , with gated access planned for the preprint release. Reproduction of the evaluations also requires the processed manifests, annotation-transfer outputs and comparison predictions; internal expression results require the corresponding held-out split.
blocks.zh: 代码和权重在https://huggingface.co/Portraier/VGL-stGen-0.5-Lung 上主机,预印版计划有闸机访问. 评价的复制还需要经过处理的明细表、注释-转移产出和比较预测;内部表达结果需要相应的搁置拆分。

blocks.en: Appendix B TCGA bulk RNA-seq analysis
blocks.zh: 附录B TCGA散装RNA-seq分析

blocks.en: B.1 Gene profiles and molecular endpoints
blocks.zh: B.1 联合国 基因剖面和分子端点

blocks.en: The analysis includes 459 TCGA-LUAD patients with readable diagnostic FFPE slides and primary-tumour bulk RNA-seq [ 17 ] . The deployed checkpoint predicted twenty gene symbols for each of 112 random tissue patches per slide at a 128 μ \mu m field of view. Each slide’s gene score is its fraction of patches naming that gene. The 317 evaluated genes satisfy both eligibility criteria: occurrence in predictions for at least 10% of slides and measured expression above one TPM in at least half of patients.
blocks.zh: 该分析包括459名TCGA-LUAD患者,可读诊断性FFPE滑动和一次肿瘤散装RNA-seq [17]. 部署的检查站预测,在128 μ \ mu m的视场上,每滑动112个随机组织补丁中,每块有20个基因符号。 每个滑动的基因分数是它命名该基因的补丁的一小部分. 317个被评价的基因满足两个合格标准:在预测至少10%的滑动和测量的表达中,至少有一半的病人超过一个TPM.

blocks.en: Measured expression was transformed as log2(TPM+1), and both measured and image-derived matrices were centred within gene. This centres the analysis on between-patient variation for each gene. Per-gene Pearson correlations were assessed with BH-FDR, with shuffled patient pairing providing a null comparison. Marker-programme scores were compared separately. Lymphoid, smooth-muscle, stromal, endothelial and alveolar programmes met FDR < 0.05; epithelial/tumour and myeloid programmes did not. Proliferation was not scored because MKI67 was the only eligible proliferation marker.
blocks.zh: 测量到的表达式被转化成log2(TPM+1),测量到的和图像产生的矩阵都以基因为中心. 这集中了对每个基因的患者间变化的分析。 与BH-FDR(英语:BH-FDR)评估了Pearson的亲缘关系,洗发病人配对提供了无效的比较. 标记程序分数分别比较. 淋巴、光滑肌肉、结节、内皮和高血压方案满足了FDR < 0.05;上皮/肿瘤和肌瘤方案没有满足。 扩散没有得分,因为MKI67是唯一合格的扩散标记.

blocks.en: Fig. 4(b) shows the programme correlations and the significance marked in the original plot. Of 317 genes, 152 met the FDR threshold, versus a permutation-null 95th percentile of one.
blocks.zh: 图4(b)显示了方案的相关性和原图中标注的意义。 在317个基因中,152个基因达到了FDR阈值,相对于一个基因中一个基因的常温-零下95个百分点.

blocks.en: B.2 Patient matching and covariate controls
blocks.zh: B.2 患者匹配和共变控制

blocks.en: Each slide’s matching bulk profile was ranked among all 459 patients. The median rank was the 29.5th percentile, compared with chance 50; restricting candidates to the same tissue source site gave 27.9. The correct patient was in the top 10% for 22% of slides. Shuffling slide–bulk pairing gave a median rank of 48.3 and no significant genes. Sequencing depth, magnification, source site and tumour fraction together explained cross-validated R² = 0.015; adding the image-derived gene profile increased R² by 0.057.
blocks.zh: 每张幻灯片相匹配的批量简介在所有459名病人中排名。 中位数是29.5百分位数,而机会是50;将候选人限制在同一组织源地27.9。 在22%的幻灯片中,正确的病人位居前10%。 Shuffling lift - bulk 配对给出的中位数为48.3,没有显著的基因. 序列深度,放大,源址和肿瘤分数一起解释过交叉验证的R2=0.015;加上图像衍生的基因剖面增加了R2的0.057.

blocks.en: B.3 Visualisation and scope
blocks.zh: B.3 视觉和范围

blocks.en: Fig. 4(a) displays 24 selected genes in 459 patients, ordered by measured lymphoid score and averaged over approximately seven adjacent patients per displayed column. Both heatmaps are z-scored within gene. Programme associations and the paired versus shuffled patient-rank distributions appear in panels (b–d).
blocks.zh: 图4(a) 显示459名病人的24个选定基因,按所测淋巴分数排序,每显示一栏平均约有7名相邻病人。 两个热图都是在基因内Z分数. 方案协会和配对与排队的病人级别分布出现在小组中(b-d)。

blocks.en: The bulk measurements and diagnostic slides come from different tissue blocks. The separate named-gene maps in Fig. 4(e) illustrate applying molecular queries across one slide and are described in the application methods.
blocks.zh: 批量测量和诊断幻灯片来自不同的组织块. 图4(e)中单独的命名基因图说明将分子查询应用到一个幻灯片,并在应用方法中加以说明。

blocks.en: Appendix C Application analysis methods
blocks.zh: 附录C 应用分析方法

blocks.en: C.1 Single-cell and Xenium cell typing
blocks.zh: C.1 单细胞和nium细胞打字

blocks.en: We evaluated genes → \rightarrow cell type (Task 1) with the checkpoint (merged bfloat16 weights, constrained decoding). GSE127465 comprises seven treatment-naive NSCLC patients with published annotations [ 42 ] . After removal of housekeeping, mitochondrial and ribosomal genes, the analysis retains 2,000 highly variable genes and samples 7,993 tumour-tissue cells. Each input contains the twenty highest-expressed retained genes in rank order. Macrophage/monocyte and conventional dendritic-cell predictions are combined as MoMacDC to match the eleven-class reference. Patient-specific malignant clusters are treated as epithelial, with an additional analysis excluding them.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了基因 ~\ 右侧细胞类型(任务1) 与检查点(合并的bfloat16重量,限制解码). GSE127465由7名治疗性NSCLC患者组成,并发表说明[42]. 切除内脏,线粒体和肋骨基因后,分析保留了2,000个高度可变性基因和7,993个肿瘤组织细胞样本. 每种输入都包含按排列顺序排列的20个最高表达保留基因. Macrophage/monocyte和常规的凹槽细胞预测被合并为MoMacDC,以匹配11级的参考. 患者特异性恶性组群被作为上皮细胞处理,另外一项分析排除了它们.

blocks.en: The 10x Xenium Human Lung Cancer FFPE application [ 16 ] samples 12,000 cells with at least ten transcripts from a 377-gene panel. Marker scores z-score each gene across cells and average within canonical sets; 39 of 78 markers are present on the panel. Fig. 3 shows the GSE127465 comparison, the Xenium marker matrix and an aligned post-Xenium H&E field. The epithelial marker set contains EPCAM alone and the predicted pDC group contains one cell. The Xenium comparison relies on markers rather than independent labels.
blocks.zh: 10xXnium人类肺癌FFPE应用[16]样本12,000个细胞,至少有377基因面板的10个笔录. 标记得分为Z分,每个基因跨细胞,在犬科组内均分;面板上有78个标记中的39个. 图3显示了GSE127465比较,Xenium标记矩阵和一个对齐的Xenium后H&E字段. 额定标记集单独包含EPCAM,预测的pDC组包含一个单元格. Xenium比较依赖于标记而不是独立的标签.

blocks.en: Balanced accuracy is 0.815 and macro-F1 0.819, with balanced accuracy 0.814 after malignant-cell exclusion and 0.70–0.86 per patient. Major confusions were that 47% of NK cells were called T cells, 46% of pDCs were called plasma cells, and 22% of B cells were called T cells. Confidence was lower for incorrect calls (median 0.47 vs 0.83). Balanced accuracy falls to 0.775 after gene-order shuffling and 0.282 without filtering. Xenium weighted purity is 0.916 across twenty-four unsupervised clusters. These application results use their own preprocessing and harmonised label space and are separate from the main 224,210-item evaluation.
blocks.zh: 平衡精度为0.815和macro-F1 0.819,恶性细胞排斥后平衡精度为0.814,每个病人0.70–0.86. 主要的混乱是,47%的NK细胞被称为T细胞,46%的pDC被称为血浆细胞,22%的B细胞被称为T细胞. 对错误电话的信心较低(中间数0.47对0.83)。 平衡精度在基因顺序洗牌后降至0.775,不过滤则降至0.282. nium的加权纯度在24个无监督的集群中为0.916. 这些应用结果使用自己的预处理和统一标签空间,与主要224,210项评价分开.

blocks.en: C.2 Whole-slide named-gene illustration
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 全滑命名基因插图

blocks.en: Fig. 4 uses TCGA-49-4510 with 526 tiles of 128 μ \mu m. Each tile image was paired with gene names and no observed expression levels, outside the benchmarked Task 11 input condition. Four displayed maps concern EPCAM, CD3E, ACTA2 and PECAM1. High was not emitted in this application; four of the five permitted levels were used. Bulk RNA was extracted from a different tissue block than the diagnostic slide.
blocks.zh: 图4使用TCGA-49-4510,526瓦128 μ\mu m. 每个瓦片图像都与基因名称配对,没有观测到的表达水平,超出了基准任务11输入条件. 展出的四张地图涉及EPCAM、CD3E、ACTA2和PECAM1。 申请中没有排放高值;在5个允许的级别中,使用了4个。 批量RNA是从一个不同于诊断幻灯片的组织块中提取的.

blocks.en: Appendix D Multimodal benchmark protocol
blocks.zh: 附录D 多式联运基准协议

blocks.en: The benchmark evaluates VGL-stGen and ten off-the-shelf medical or general-purpose multimodal models on the same thirteen tasks. The comparator families are MedGemma [ 9 ] , Gemma 3 [ 18 ] , Gemma 4 [ 19 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 20 ] , Qwen3.8 [ 21 ] , DeepSeek-VL2 [ 22 ] and GLM-4.6V-Flash [ 23 ] . The full GLM-4.6V checkpoint is not included. Table 10 specifies the task-level settings. Task identifiers refer to the deployed task inventory.
blocks.zh: 该基准评价了VGL-stGen和10个现成医疗或通用多式联运模式的相同13项任务。 参照系为MedGemma [9],Gemma 3 [18],Gemma 4 [19],Quen3-VL [20],Quen3.8 [21],DeepSeek-VL2 [22]和GLM-4.6V-Flash [23]. 不包括完整的GLM-4.6V检查站。 表10列出了任务级别设置。 任务识别符是指部署的任务清单.

blocks.en: Table 10: Fixed task evaluation settings shared across models. Tokens are maximum generated tokens; T11–12 instead make 25 autoregressive level choices per row. T2–3 preserve the original mixed-task batch composition. Counts are per task. All tasks except T4 use NF4; T4 uses BF16. Task key: T1, genes → \rightarrow cell type; T2, image + genes → \rightarrow cell type; T3, image → \rightarrow cell type; T4, image → \rightarrow binary tumor status; T5, image → \rightarrow nine-class tissue type; T6, image → \rightarrow gene names; T7, cell type → \rightarrow gene names; T8, image + partial gene list → \rightarrow missing gene names; T9, cell type + partial gene list → \rightarrow missing gene names; T10, image → \rightarrow very-high-expression gene names; T11, image + observed levels → \rightarrow queried levels; T12, cell type + observed levels → \rightarrow queried levels; T13, gene–level pairs → \rightarrow cell type.
blocks.zh: 表10:不同模式共享的固定任务评价设置。 托肯是最大生成的符;T11–12转而每行选择25个自动递归级. T2–3保留了最初的混合任务批次组成. 计数是每个任务。 除T4外的所有任务都使用NF4;T4使用BF16. 任务键:T1,基因 → 右侧细胞类型;T2,影像+基因 → 右侧细胞类型;T3,影像→ 右侧细胞类型;T4,影像→ 右侧二元肿瘤状况;T5,影像→ 右侧九级组织类型;T6,影像→ 右侧基因名称;T7,细胞类型→ 右侧基因名称;T8,影像+ 部分基因列表 → 右侧基因名称;T9,细胞类型+ 部分基因列表 → 右侧缺失基因名称;T10,影像~ 右侧非常表达基因名称;T11,影像+ 观测水平 → 右侧空间询问水平;T12,细胞类型+观测水平 → 右侧空间询问水平;T13,基因– 水平对子→ 右侧细胞类型.

blocks.en: The original task pipeline supplies inputs and instructions, collates batches, extracts answers and computes scores. The same canonical image files and molecular context are supplied to every model, with model-native image processing and chat templates. Consequently, matched inputs do not imply identical resized tensors, visual-token counts or tokenized instruction lengths. Table 11 identifies the exact model repositories and image-processing configurations. Full revisions, library versions and source hashes are included with the ancillary benchmark data.

blocks.en: Task 4 uses BF16 weights; all other tasks use NF4 double quantization with BF16 computation in quantized layers. VGL-stGen uses its merged model for task 4 and its deployed adapter for the other tasks. Gemma 4’s multimodal projection and vision modules excluded by its loading configuration remain unquantized; k-bit preparation can cast unquantized parameters to FP32. DeepSeek uses eager language attention throughout and its native memory-efficient vision attention. Other models use SDPA for tasks 1–9 and eager attention for tasks 10–13. Model-dependent loading and tokenization adaptations preserve the requested input and score definition.

blocks.en: For categorical outputs, allowed-label tries are constructed with each tokenizer. Gene-list outputs are parsed using the original permissive gene parser. Expression completion fixes the 25 gene names and selects successive level tokens autoregressively; prefix-sharing tokens are handled as branches of the allowed-level trie. Model-specific end-of-turn markers delimit the answer, and complete raw generations are retained for audit. Structured result records are not counted as evidence that a model freely generated valid JSON.
blocks.zh: 对于绝对的输出,允许的标签尝试会用每个表示器构建. 基因列表输出使用原始允许基因解析器解析. 表达式完成修复了25个基因名称,并自动选择了相继的关卡符;前缀共享符作为允许关卡符的分支处理. 具体模型的转折末端标记划定答案,完整的生代保留供审计. 结构化的结果记录不作为模型自由生成有效的JSON的证据.

blocks.en: For task 5, the same pooled marginal-probability correction is applied to each model. Raw and corrected macro-F1 are both reported. This is a transductive comparison on the development subset, and the correction was selected after labelled evaluation. For task 10, the requested gene-list length is the true answer length. Tasks 11 and 12 retain 75 observed levels; this benchmark is conditional completion rather than expression prediction from H&E alone.

blocks.en: Table 13 repeats tasks 6–10 and 13 with output constraints, for all eleven models. Gene-list decoding enforces array syntax while permitting unrestricted gene-symbol strings made of letters, digits, periods and hyphens. It supplies neither a gene-panel whitelist nor the biological answer. Levels-to-cell-type decoding permits the printed, lowercase and uppercase spellings of each label, with case-insensitive scoring. Inputs, token limits, batches and metrics are unchanged. A maximum-token cutoff can still truncate an output, so this arm does not guarantee that every generation is complete JSON.

blocks.en: VGL-stGen retains its reported scores. Several comparators improve, including MedGemma’s levels-to-cell-type accuracy from 0.0000 to 0.3620 and Gemma4-31B’s from 0.4620 to 0.4720. VGL-stGen remains at 0.7420; its paired difference from Gemma4-31B is 0.2700, with 95% interval [0.2380, 0.3020]. The two cell-type-conditioned gene-list tasks remain close to Gemma4-31B. Thus, enforcing output format does not remove the principal image-gene and cell-typing gaps, but the comparison remains conditional on the fixed generation budgets.
blocks.zh: VGL-stGen保留其报告的分数. 几个比较国有所改进,包括MedGemma的对细胞型精度从0.000到0.3620,Gemma4-31B的精度从0.4620到0.4720。 VGL-stGen仍为0.7420;其与Gemma4-31B的配对差为0.270,间隔为95% [0.2380,0.3020]. 两个细胞型有条件的基因列表任务仍然接近Gemma4-31B. 因此,执行产出格式并不能消除主要图像生成和单元格模式的空白,但比较仍以固定生成预算为条件。

blocks.en: Inspection of low-scoring MedGemma outputs shows that intermediate reasoning often consumes the available generation budget. Parsed free-list outputs can also name genes outside the evaluation panel or use aliases not mapped by the scorer. Out-of-panel genes are not necessarily fictitious. These observations explain why a near-zero score under this protocol should not be read as absence of biological knowledge. Under format constraints, MedGemma predicts T cells in 999 of 1,000 levels-to-cell-type rows, yielding the majority-label score. A supplementary diagnostic on the first 100 rows uses full-label likelihood scoring, rather than the primary decoder: removing the molecular input preserves a constant prediction, whereas reversing candidate order changes that prediction. This diagnostic identifies sensitivity to the readout and candidate ordering without establishing a biological mechanism for the bias.
blocks.zh: 对评分低的MedGemma产出的检查表明,中间推理往往消耗可用的生成预算. 解析的自由列表输出也可以在评价面板外命名基因,或使用评分器没有绘制的别名. 舱外基因不一定是虚构的. 这些意见解释了为什么该议定书规定的近零分不应被理解为缺乏生物知识。 在格式限制下,MedGemma在1000级对细胞型行的999中预测T细胞,得出多数标签分数. 前100行的辅助诊断使用全标签概率评分,而不是主解码器:去除分子输入会保留一个恒定的预测,而反转候选的顺序改变这个预测. 这种诊断方法确定了对读取和候选订单的敏感性,而没有为偏差建立生物机制。

On 1,000 rows per task, free-generation pair-F1 is 0.0361 (image) and 0.0123 (cell type); fixed-name autoregressive decoding gives 0.6596 and 0.6858 with unchanged weights. These tables omit visible levels. At 75 observed levels, full-input MLP references score higher on both tasks (Table 14).

Level-only exceeds full-answer supervision on the image task by +0.00848, sample CI [0.00561, 0.01015]; the direction is positive in every seed on both platforms (Fig. 7). blocks.en: Absent targets comprise 61.36% (image) and 58.92% (cell type). blocks.en: Across three training seeds, intact-minus-permuted pair-F1 is +0.00597 [0.00316, 0.00764] for full-answer and +0.00776 [0.00263, 0.01042] for level-only supervision (sample CIs). On the pooled image benchmark, per-seed differences are positive in both conditions. The between-objective difference is +0.00179 [ − - 0.00067, 0.00336], leaving an increase in the image-pairing effect unresolved.

blocks.en: For the fixed level-only seed-42 checkpoint, reducing observed levels from 75 to 25 lowers image pair-F1 from 0.68032 to 0.65992. The change in image-pairing effect remains unresolved. The extended methods report all budgets and secondary metrics under Completion with fewer observed expression levels.
blocks.zh: 对于固定等级的只种子-42检查站,观测到的等级从75级降至25级,图像对-F1从0.68032降至0.65992. 图像制作效应的变化仍未得到解决。 扩展方法报告所有预算和二级衡量标准都在完成中,观察到的表达水平较少。

blocks.en: G.7 Reference fits and label definitions
blocks.zh: G.7 参照和标签定义

blocks.en: Distribution-shift studies motivate comparing transferred performance with within-cohort fits [ 46 , 47 , 48 , 49 ] . In this study, the range of transferred scores is 2.09 times the range of target-cohort scores across nine gene comparators and 2.17 times that range across fourteen cancer encoders. Target-cohort fits use additional labels, with cell-level folds for genes and patient-level folds for cancer. These ratios describe the selected comparator panels and evaluation designs.
blocks.zh: 分配转移研究促使将转移业绩与内部流动业绩进行比较[46、47、48、49]。 在这项研究中,转移的分数范围是9个基因比较国的目标-码分数范围的2.09倍,以及14个癌症编码器的2.17倍。 目标-合位配位使用附加标签,基因的细胞级折叠和癌症的患者级折叠. 这些比率说明了选定的参照小组和评价设计。

blocks.en: On the same 452 slides, refitting each cancer probe under the wide (TUMOR, NECROSIS and MIXED counted as positive) and TUMOR-only mappings yields a median paired difference of 0.1191 balanced accuracy, compared with 0.0436 for the colour reference. Each encoder’s patient-paired interval excludes zero. Target definition, prevalence and probe fitting change together. Because the mapping was chosen during development, this is an exploratory measure of benchmark sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 在同样的452张幻灯片上,在宽度(TUMOR,NECROSIS和MIXED计算为正值)下重新配置每个癌症探测器,TUMOR只绘制图,得出中位对比差0.1191平衡精度,而颜色参考值为0.0436. 每个编码器的病人间隔不包括0。 目标定义、流行程度和探索 将变化结合起来 由于制图是在开发期间选择的,因此这是对基准敏感性的探索性衡量。

blocks.en: Patient-level resampling of the binary VGL-stGen result gives an interval of [0.7441, 0.7622], compared with the slide interval [0.7452, 0.7610]. This sensitivity analysis accounts for repeated slides from a patient. Annotation error and adaptive development remain outside both intervals. Additional comparisons and implementation details appear in the supplementary methods and figures.
blocks.zh: 二进制VGL-stGen结果的患者级复标给出了[0.7441,0.7622]的间隔,与幻灯片间隔[0.7452,0.7610]相比. 这种灵敏度分析是病人反复滑动的原因. 注释错误和适应性开发仍然处于两个间隔之外。 其他比较和执行细节见补充方法和数字。
